comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Fortinet sells network security firewalls and SD-WAN, not IoT connectivity hardware or remote device management.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: KORE sells IoT connectivity management, routers and gateways to device makers and enterprises, with recurring per-device subscriptions like Digi.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: PowerFleet is a fleet and asset telematics solution provider, a vertical application rather than general IoT connectivity hardware.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: PTC sells CAD and PLM engineering software to manufacturers, not connectivity hardware; its IoT software is minor.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Ribbon sells carrier voice and IP/optical networking gear to telecom operators, a different business and customer base.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Zebra sells barcode scanners, printers and mobile computers for data capture, not IoT connectivity routers and modules.
